We’re also helping to green the power grid through our advocacy of
clean energy policies and our support for renewable energy procurement
programs. For example, we worked with business and government
stakeholders in Taiwan to share our experience with the benefits of corporate
renewable energy purchasing and to support the creation of new purchasing
channels for companies. We were pleased to see that Taiwan passed a law
in January 2017 to allow end-users to directly purchase renewable energy
for their operations. In 2018, we signed our inaugural renewable energy deal
in Asia, the first such corporate power purchase agreement in Taiwan. We
will purchase the output of a 10 MW solar array (which is part of a larger
solar farm) in Tainan City, Taiwan. It will deploy 40,000 solar panels across
commercial fishing ponds, maximizing land-use efficiency and benefiting
local aquaculture workers. This will boost the carbon-free profile of our local
data center.
